description: Regression fixtures for the second wave of ADHD-inspired ideate fine-tunes: local embedding convergence detector, /ideate command, interactive Phase 4, and cost estimate brief.

evals.task: Verify that hooks/hooks.json registers ideate-convergence-capture.sh on SessionEnd and that the hook file exists.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references ideate-convergence-capture.sh
At least one of the checked files references SessionEnd
At least one of the checked files references Ollama
At least one of the checked files references ideate-embeddings.jsonl
evals.fixed_by: fine-tune: add local embedding convergence detector

evals.task: Verify that scripts/ideate-convergence.py exists and can run (stdlib-only query mode) on an empty state directory.
success_criteria: stdout contains No convergence records found

evals.task: Verify that commands/ideate.md exists with the expected frontmatter and keeps model invocation enabled (auto-fire on vague open-ended prompts is the load-bearing use case).
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references name: ideate
At least one of the checked files references ideate command
At least one of the checked files references disable-model-invocation: false
At least one of the checked files references /ideate

evals.task: Verify that commands/ideate.md documents Phase 4 interactive deepen and cost estimate in the brief.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references Phase 4
At least one of the checked files references Interactive deepen
At least one of the checked files references Deepen #2
At least one of the checked files references Re-run with frames
At least one of the checked files references Combine A and B
At least one of the checked files references Cost estimate

evals.fixed_by: fine-tune: add Phase 4 + cost estimate to ideate skill body
